notes:
Lead source: self-serve sign-up (trial credits). Customer profile: SMB (field ops + mobile SDKs) — needs a hosted API that 'just works' and scales. Primary app is a chat + document summarization feature used by on-site technicians; secondary is reranking for search results. Key asks: low tail-latency (p95 < 300ms), cost predictability (target $0.50-$1.50 per 1k prompt tokens after batching), easy model upgrades via API.

Conversation highlights / direct quotes: 
- CTO Priyanka Rao: "We need something close to GPT-4 for nuanced instructions but can't afford high unit cost — aiming for ~80% quality at ~25% of the cost."
- ML Lead Jordan: "Interested in Llama 2 13B finetuned vs Mistral large; curious about Qwen 7B quantized for cost savings."

Model-selection questions captured: 
- Which model gives best instruction-following for troubleshooting guides (Llama 2 13B, Mistral 7B/8B, Qwen 7B)?
- How much quality delta should we expect between FP16 hosted variants vs 4-bit quantized variants for our dialogue prompts?
- Can Redwood hosted routing fall back to cheaper quantized variant automatically when under budget/capacity constraints?
- Latency expectation: network to Redwood host + model p95 must stay <300ms for short prompts (<=256 tokens).
- Cost sensitivity: expected 100k-300k tokens/day during POC; want clear per-token estimates and optimized batching suggestions.

POC plan proposed (notes):
- 2-week timebox on Hosted API; run parallel A/B comparing: (A) Llama 2 13B FP16, (B) Mistral 7B FP16, (C) Qwen 7B 4-bit quantized.
- Metrics: response correctness (human eval on 300 prompts), latency p50/p95, tokens cost & per-response $ estimate, hallucination rate on grounding tasks.
- Deliverable: short evaluation deck + recommendations for production model & routing policy.

Operational / security items: 
- They require SSO for admin console and audit logging for token usage. Data residency: US only preferred.
- Finance wants a capped spend setting for hosted usage during POC.

Stated blockers / risk: 
- Internal procurement needs a simple security FAQ to approve third-party hosted API.
- Concern about switching models mid-traffic — wants a clear rollback/fallback plan.

Suggested Redwood actions: 
- Provide sample hosted token pricing for each model variant and an estimated POC bill.
- Share a short note on expected quality delta between FP16 and 4-bit quantized runs for each model family.
- Provide an example routing policy (hosted) that falls back to quantized cheaper model when latency/cost thresholds are hit.
- Attach SSO checklist and basic SOC2 summary (drive links above).
